selection_policy.zh-CN: 10月28日至11月30日已按具体机构资料、研究资料及百科事件页逐条编选和核对；其余日期保留首版日期页整理资料。中英文为本站简短转述。核对所引来源不等于逐条原始档案审定；各条来源和核查范围见完整说明。历史月日沿用所引来源的记法，必要时注明当地日期或历法；内容不是重要性排名。 第二版另选文集第10卷年表中50条精确到日的马恩事件，重复事件升级来源；英文为本站译文（AI辅助），不把编者年表核查冒称原始档案审定。
selection_policy.en: October 28–November 30 has been expanded through editorial reading of institutional, research and encyclopedic event sources; other dates retain the initial anniversary-page collection. Chinese and English are brief accounts prepared for this site. Checking the cited sources is not a claim of original-archive verification. Source notes explain coverage and calendar conventions; entries are not ranked by importance. The second edition also selects 50 precisely dated Marx and Engels events from the chronology in Wenji volume 10, upgrading existing entries where duplicated. English is a site translation assisted by AI; source review is not original-archive verification.

title.zh-CN: 大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国
title.en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

text.zh-CN: 大不列颠王国和爱尔兰王国根据《联合法令》建立大不列颠暨爱尔兰联合王国。
text.en: The kingdoms of Great Britain and Ireland united under the Acts of Union.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联发射月球1号探测器。
text.en: The Soviet Union launched the Luna 1 probe.

items.source: NASA

text.zh-CN: 在美国独立战争期间，乔治·华盛顿率领的军队在普林斯顿战役中击败英国军队。
text.en: American Revolutionary War: American forces commanded by George Washington defeated British troops at the Battle of Princeton.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国音乐杂志《公告牌》首次公布音乐榜单，后来成为西洋音乐界重要的评比依据。
text.en: Billboard published its first music hit parade.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国天文学家迈克尔·E·布朗团队分析帕洛马山天文台拍摄的照片，发现矮行星阋神星。
text.en: The dwarf planet Eris was discovered by a team using images from the Samuel Oschin telescope at Palomar Observatory.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国地质学家阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳提出大陆漂移学说，后来被纳入板块构造论。
text.en: German geophysicist Alfred Wegener presented his theory of continental drift, the precursor of plate tectonics, to the German Geological Society.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 伽利略开始用望远镜观测木星的大卫星。
text.en: Galileo began his telescopic observations of Jupiter's large moons.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 根据日本漫画家青山刚昌的知名推理漫画改编的电视动画《名侦探柯南》于读卖电视台首播。
text.en: The television anime Detective Conan premiered on Yomiuri TV in Japan.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国科学院公开由发明家暨艺术家路易·达盖尔以自己的名字命名的相片摄影技术达盖尔银版法。
text.en: The French Academy of Sciences announced Louis Daguerre's photographic process, the daguerreotype.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国伦敦派丁顿车站和法灵顿站之间的大都会线通车，为世界上第一条地铁路线。
text.en: Service began on the Metropolitan Railway between Paddington and Farringdon Street, today the oldest segment of the London Underground.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 阿尔巴尼亚社会主义人民共和国

text.zh-CN: 阿尔巴尼亚人民共和国宣告成立。
text.en: The People's Republic of Albania was proclaimed.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国心理学教授詹姆斯·贝德福德因肾癌逝世后，成为第一例使用人体冷冻技术保存的遗体。
text.en: Seventy-three-year-old psychology professor James Bedford became the first person to be cryonically preserved with intent of future resuscitation.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 西班牙王国和葡萄牙王国签订《马德里条约》，取代先前的《托德西利亚斯条约》。
text.en: Spain and Portugal signed the Treaty of Madrid to revise their colonial boundaries.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 义大利作曲家贾科莫·普契尼的歌剧《托斯卡》在罗马歌剧院首次演出。
text.en: Giacomo Puccini's opera Tosca, based on the play La Tosca by French dramatist Victorien Sardou, premiered at the Teatro Costanzi in Rome.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 位于英国伦敦布卢姆茨伯里的大英博物馆正式开放，为世界规模最大的博物馆之一。
text.en: The British Museum opened to the public in London.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 音乐剧《你好，多莉！》在纽约百老汇首演。
text.en: Hello, Dolly! opened on Broadway in New York.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 詹姆士·库克的第二次探险

text.zh-CN: 英国探险家詹姆士·库克的决心号在第二次探险途中，创下横跨南极圈的纪录。
text.en: James Cook's ship Resolution became the first vessel to cross the Antarctic Circle.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 韩国釜山开始建造联合国纪念墓园，这是世上唯一的联合国墓地。
text.en: Construction of the United Nations Military Cemetery began in Busan, South Korea.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国太空探测器新视野号发射升空，为首艘研究冥王星及其卫星的探测器。
text.en: NASA launched New Horizons on its mission to Pluto and beyond.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纳粹德国官员在万湖会议上协调对欧洲犹太人的灭绝计划。
text.en: Nazi officials met at the Wannsee Conference to coordinate the genocide of European Jews.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国国民公会判处国王路易十六犯下背叛国家罪，并在革命广场斩首处决。
text.en: French Revolution: After being found guilty of high treason by the National Convention, Louis XVI was guillotined in Paris.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 埃沃·莫拉莱斯就任玻利维亚总统，成为该国第一位美洲原住民总统。
text.en: Evo Morales was inaugurated as President of Bolivia, becoming the country's first indigenous president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 布莱克韦尔取得医学学位

text.zh-CN: 伊丽莎白·布莱克韦尔从纽约日内瓦医学院毕业，成为首位在美国取得医学学位的女性。
text.en: Elizabeth Blackwell graduated from Geneva Medical College, becoming the first woman to receive a medical degree in the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空暨太空总署发射的航海家2号探测器成为首个掠过天王星的太空探测器。
text.en: Voyager 2 became the first spacecraft to fly past Uranus.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 乌干达陆军总司令伊迪·阿明发动军事政变，推翻总统米尔顿·奥博特的统治。
text.en: Idi Amin seized power from Ugandan president Milton Obote in a coup d'état, beginning eight years of military rule.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纳粹德国和波兰第二共和国签署《德波互不侵犯条约》，承诺10年内放弃武装冲突。
text.en: Germany and Poland signed a ten-year non-aggression declaration.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 天文学家记录到小熊座的白矮星H1504+65，其表面温度高达200,000 K，为当时已知表面温度最高的白矮星。
text.en: Astronomers reported on the exceptionally hot white dwarf H1504+65.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 挑战者号航天飞机灾难

text.zh-CN: 美国挑战者号航天飞机在发射升空73秒后爆炸解体，造成7名宇航员死亡。
text.en: The Space Shuttle Challenger disintegrated 73 seconds into its tenth mission (video featured), killing all seven crew members.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在夏威夷王国国王卡拉卡瓦逝世后，其妹妹利留卡拉尼登基成为夏威夷女王。
text.en: Liliʻuokalani, the last monarch and only queen regnant of the Hawaiian Kingdom, ascended the throne.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在第二次英格兰内战战败后，英格兰国王查理一世在国宴厅前遭公开斩首。
text.en: King Charles I, who was defeated in both the First and the Second English Civil Wars, was beheaded for high treason in front of the Banqueting House in London.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联第一颗在月球上成功实现软着陆的探测器月球9号在拜科努尔发射场发射升空。
text.en: The Soviet Union launched the Luna 9 lunar probe from Baikonur.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国牛津大学出版社出版詹姆斯·穆雷主编的《牛津英语词典》，共计352页。
text.en: The first fascicle of the Oxford English Dictionary, a 352-page volume that covered words from A to ant, was published.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纽约中央车站正式开放。
text.en: Grand Central Terminal opened in New York City.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联太空探测器月球9号成功降落在月球表面上，成为首颗在月球软着陆的机器人太空载具。
text.en: Luna 9 became the first spacecraft to achieve a soft landing on the Moon.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 前大陆军总司令乔治·华盛顿获得全体选举人团支持，当选第一任美国总统。
text.en: George Washington was unanimously elected the first president of the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 比利时化学家利奥·贝克兰公布合成塑料酚醛树脂的发明。
text.en: Belgian chemist Leo Baekeland announced his invention of Bakelite, a synthetic plastic.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国和美国签署《同盟条约》和《友好贸易条约》，确立两国军事和商业同盟。
text.en: France and the United States signed the Treaty of Amity and Commerce and the Treaty of Alliance, respectively establishing commercial and military ties between the two nations.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 海地总统让·克劳德·杜瓦利埃下台。
text.en: President of Haiti Jean-Claude Duvalier fled the country after a popular uprising, ending 28 years of one-family rule in the nation.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纳斯达克股票市场开始运作。
text.en: The Nasdaq stock market began operating.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国达姆城亥姆霍兹重离子研究中心的研究团队首次成功合成出化学元素鿔。
text.en: Researchers at the GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research in Darmstadt, Germany, first created the chemical element copernicium.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国铱卫星33号和俄罗斯宇宙2251卫星在地球轨道发生首起卫星碰撞事故。
text.en: The satellites Iridium 33 and Kosmos 2251 destroyed each other in the first accidental hypervelocity collision between two intact satellites in low Earth orbit.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 汤玛斯·坎贝尔和亨利·布鲁厄姆创办伦敦大学，为英国第一所世俗大学。
text.en: London University, later University College London, was founded as the first secular university in England.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国太空探测器会合-舒梅克号登陆爱神星，为第一个登陆小行星的探测器。
text.en: The NASA space probe NEAR Shoemaker touched down on Eros, becoming the first spacecraft to land on an asteroid.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 比利时布鲁塞尔政府对污染严重的塞讷河展开覆盖工程，并推进都市更新。
text.en: Work began on the covering of the Senne, burying the polluted main river of Brussels to allow for urban renewal in the centre of the city.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国伯克利的研究人员首次合成化学元素铹。
text.en: Researchers at Berkeley first synthesized the element lawrencium.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 普鲁士、奥地利和萨克森签署《胡贝图斯堡条约》，七年战争结束。
text.en: Prussia, Austria and Saxony signed the Treaty of Hubertusburg, ending their Seven Years' War hostilities.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在推翻富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔政权后，菲德尔·卡斯特罗出任古巴共和国总理。
text.en: Fidel Castro was sworn in as Prime Minister of Cuba, beginning his decades-long rule over the country.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 科索沃议会通过总理哈希姆·萨奇宣读的独立宣言，单方面宣布脱离塞尔维亚独立。
text.en: Kosovo's parliament adopted a declaration of independence from Serbia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 孟买水兵起义爆发。
text.en: The Royal Indian Navy mutiny began in Bombay.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联和平号空间站第一个模组核心舱发射升空，为人类首个进行长期研究工作的太空站。
text.en: The Soviet Union launched the core module of the Mir space station.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 由义大利作曲家焦阿基诺·罗西尼创作的歌剧《塞维亚的理发师》在罗马首次演出。
text.en: The Barber of Seville, an opera buffa composed by Gioachino Rossini, premiered at the Teatro Argentina in Rome to jeers from the audience.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 联合国发起的《精神药物公约》在奥地利维也纳签署。
text.en: The Convention on Psychotropic Substances was signed in Vienna.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 克隆羊多莉向公众公布

text.zh-CN: 苏格兰罗斯林研究所公布克隆羊多莉的诞生。
text.en: Scientists at the Roslin Institute announced Dolly, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 天文学家在大麦哲伦云中观测到超新星1987A。
text.en: Supernova SN 1987A was observed in the Large Magellanic Cloud.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 盖欧格·弗里德里希·韩德尔的《里纳尔多》首演，这是第一部专门为伦敦舞台创作的义大利歌剧。
text.en: George Frideric Handel's Rinaldo, the first Italian-language opera written specifically for the London stage, premiered.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 关于个人崇拜及其后果
title.en: On the Cult of Personality and Its Consequences

text.zh-CN: 苏联共产党领袖赫鲁晓夫在第二十次代表大会发表批判斯大林的秘密报告。
text.en: In a speech to the 20th Congress of the Communist Party, Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev denounced the personality cult and dictatorship of his predecessor Joseph Stalin.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 大日本帝国陆军皇道派青年军官在东京发动政变，刺杀大藏大臣高桥是清等多名阁员及将领。
text.en: Imperial Japanese Army troops attempted a coup d'etat, occupying parts of Tokyo, and killing several politicians, including finance minister Takahashi Korekiyo.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 由游戏公司Game Freak开发的《宝可梦 红／绿》在日本发售，为该系列首部作品。
text.en: The multimedia franchise Pokémon was launched with the release of the video games Pocket Monsters Red and Green.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国军队废黜伊默里纳王国女王腊纳瓦洛娜三世，马达加斯加成为法国殖民地。
text.en: Ranavalona III, the last sovereign ruler of the Kingdom of Madagascar, was deposed by French military forces.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 麦克丹尼尔获得奥斯卡奖

text.zh-CN: 哈蒂·麦克丹尼尔凭《乱世佳人》获得奥斯卡最佳女配角奖，成为首位获得奥斯卡奖的非裔美国人。
text.en: Hattie McDaniel won Best Supporting Actress for Gone with the Wind, becoming the first African American to win an Oscar.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国物理学家亨利·贝克勒在感光底片实验过程中，意外发现铀元素具有发出辐射的放射性。
text.en: Henri Becquerel discovered evidence of uranium's radioactivity while studying photographic plates.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 墨属德克萨斯代表大会宣布脱离墨西哥而独立，建立德克萨斯共和国。
text.en: Texas Revolution: At a convention of delegates in Washington-on-the-Brazos, the Mexican state of Texas adopted a declaration of independence, establishing the Republic of Texas.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 位于怀俄明州的肖肖尼国家森林正式成立，为美国第一个受到联邦保护的国家森林。
text.en: Shoshone National Forest in Wyoming was established as the first national forest in the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 大陆军带加农炮发动多彻斯特高地争夺战，以解波士顿之围。
text.en: American Revolutionary War: Using artillery transported from Ticonderoga, the Continental Army occupied Dorchester Heights, forcing the British to abandon Boston two weeks later.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国研制的喷火战斗机原型机在南安普敦首次试飞，为第二次世界大战欧洲战区主要机种。
text.en: The prototype of the Supermarine Spitfire flew for the first time.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.en: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society

text.zh-CN: 英国皇家学会出版科学期刊《自然科学会报》创刊号。
text.en: The Royal Society published the first issue of Philosophical Transactions.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天局的开普勒空间望远镜发射升空，其后用于发现类地行星。
text.en: The Kepler space telescope, designed to discover Earth-like planets orbiting other stars, was launched.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 阿夫沙尔王朝的创始人纳迪尔沙加冕伊朗的沙阿。
text.en: Nader Shah, the founder of the Afsharid dynasty, was crowned Shah of Iran.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏格兰经济学家亚当·斯密撰写的古典经济学专著《国富论》首版出版。
text.en: Scottish philosopher Adam Smith published his book The Wealth of Nations, the first classical treatise on political economy.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国天文学家詹姆斯·埃利奥特团队利用柯伊伯机载天文台发现天王星的环系统。
text.en: Astronomers using NASA's Kuiper Airborne Observatory discovered a faint ring system around Uranus.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 义大利作曲家朱塞佩·威尔第创作的《弄臣》在威尼斯凤凰剧院首次演出。
text.en: The first performance of Verdi's Rigoletto took place at La Fenice in Venice.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 印度民族主义领袖圣雄甘地领导食盐进军运动，抗议英属印度的食盐公卖制。
text.en: Mahatma Gandhi began the Salt March, a 24-day nonviolent walk to defy the British salt tax in colonial India.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国天文学家威廉·赫歇尔在位于索美塞特郡的自宅庭院发现新的行星天王星。
text.en: William Herschel discovered the planet Uranus from the garden of his house in Bath, England, initially considering it to be a comet.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国发明家伊莱·惠特尼获得现代轧棉机的专利，其后改变美国的棉花产业。
text.en: Eli Whitney received a patent for his cotton gin.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 改编自萧伯纳剧作《卖花女》的美国音乐剧《窈窕淑女》在纽约百老汇剧院首次演出。
text.en: The musical My Fair Lady, based on George Bernard Shaw's play Pygmalion, debuted at the Mark Hellinger Theatre in New York City.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国会通过《军事和平建制法》，授权在西点设立美国军事学院。
text.en: Congress passed legislation authorizing the United States Military Academy at West Point.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 驻防于马萨诸塞州波士顿的英国陆军撤离当地，长达11个月的波士顿之围宣告结束。
text.en: American Revolutionary War: The 11‑month Siege of Boston ended with the evacuation of the city's British garrison.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 波兰、俄罗斯、乌克兰在拉脱维亚里加签署确定边界的《里加和约》，波苏战争结束。
text.en: Poland, Soviet Russia and Soviet Ukraine signed the Treaty of Riga, ending the Polish–Soviet War.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在联合国安全理事会决议实施禁飞后，数个国家开始对利比亚内战展开武装干涉。
text.en: First Libyan Civil War: The French Air Force launched Opération Harmattan, beginning foreign military intervention in Libya.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 荷兰东印度公司成立。
text.en: The Dutch East India Company was established.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 西南非正式脱离南非统治而独立为纳米比亚，萨姆·努乔马成为首任总统。
text.en: Namibia became independent of South African rule, with Sam Nujoma as its first president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 卡里劳斯·瓦西拉科斯在为首届夏季奥运做准备的过程中赢得第一场现代马拉松冠军。
text.en: Charilaos Vasilakos won the first modern marathon in preparation for the inaugural Summer Olympics.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 俄罗斯联邦航天局的和平号空间站坠入地球大气层，并在太平洋上空解体。
text.en: The Russian space agency deorbited the space station Mir, causing it to reenter the Earth's atmosphere and break up over the Pacific Ocean.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国微生物学家罗伯特·科赫向一群柏林医师发表其发现的结核病病原体结核杆菌。
text.en: German physician Robert Koch announced the discovery of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the pathogen that causes tuberculosis.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 荷兰天文学家克里斯蒂安·惠更斯使用其设计的望远镜发现土星的卫星土卫六。
text.en: Dutch astronomer Christiaan Huygens discovered Titan, the largest natural satellite of Saturn.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 禁止发展、生产和储存生物武器的《生物武器公约》正式生效。
text.en: The Biological Weapons Convention entered into force.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国华盛顿地铁向乘客开放。
text.en: The Washington Metro opened to passengers.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国务院发布《艾奇逊-李林塔尔报告》，这是一份关于核武国际控制的提案。
text.en: The US Department of State released the Acheson–Lilienthal Report, a proposal for the international control of nuclear weapons.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国女王维多利亚女王主持位於伦敦阿尔伯特城的皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅开幕式。
text.en: Queen Victoria opened the Royal Albert Hall in London.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国务卿威廉·H·苏厄德与俄罗斯达成协议，同意以720万美元购买阿拉斯加。
text.en: The United States and Russia agreed on the purchase of Alaska for 7.2 million dollars.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国与日本江户幕府签署《神奈川条约》，日本锁国体制结束。
text.en: U.S. Navy Commodore Matthew C. Perry and the Tokugawa shogunate signed the Convention of Kanagawa, forcing the opening of Japanese ports to American trade.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 中国京汉铁路全线通车。
text.en: China's Beijing–Hankou Railway opened along its full route.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 阿根廷特种部队登陆并占领英国海外领土马尔维纳斯群岛，马岛战争爆发。
text.en: Argentine special forces invaded the Falkland Islands, sparking the Falklands War against the United Kingdom.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国辉格党议员罗伯特·沃波尔取得第一财政大臣等职务，被视为首位英国首相。
text.en: Robert Walpole took office as First Lord of the Treasury, Chancellor of the Exchequer and Leader of the House of Commons, becoming the first de facto prime minister of Great Britain.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统威廉·亨利·哈里森在就职一个月后逝世，引发总统继任问题的宪政危机。
text.en: William Henry Harrison became the first U.S. president to die in office, sparking a brief constitutional crisis regarding questions of presidential succession that were unanswered by the U.S. Constitution.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美洲原住民宝嘉康蒂与英国殖民者约翰·罗尔夫结婚，确立詹姆斯敦地区的和平。
text.en: Pocahontas, a Native American woman, married English colonist John Rolfe, leading to a period of peace between the Powhatan people and the inhabitants of Jamestown, Virginia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 荷兰东印度公司船长扬·范里贝克登陆南非桌湾，并在桌山建立驻扎点开普敦。
text.en: Dutch sailor Jan van Riebeeck landed at Table Bay in southern Africa, establishing a settlement that later became known as Cape Town.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 联合国建立公共卫生专门机构世界卫生组织，布罗克·奇泽姆为首任总干事。
text.en: The United Nations established the World Health Organization to act as a coordinating authority on international public health.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 奥斯曼帝国农民在米洛斯岛发现断臂的古希腊阿芙萝黛蒂雕像「米洛的维纳斯」。
text.en: The Venus de Milo, an ancient Greek statue of a woman with its arms missing, was discovered on the island of Milos.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 以美国为首的多国部队成功占领伊拉克首都巴格达，结束萨达姆·侯赛因的独裁统治。
text.en: Invasion of Iraq: Coalition forces captured Baghdad and the statue of Saddam Hussein in Firdos Square was toppled.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 荷属东印度松巴哇岛的坦博拉火山发生大规模火山喷发，引发「无夏之年」现象。
text.en: Mount Tambora in Indonesia began the most powerful volcanic eruption in recorded history, killing at least 71,000 people and affecting temperatures worldwide.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 第六次反法同盟与法国签署《枫丹白露条约》，拿破仑一世被流放至厄尔巴岛。
text.en: The Treaty of Fontainebleau was signed, ending the War of the Sixth Coalition and forcing Napoleon to abdicate as ruler of France and sending him into exile on Elba.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联太空人尤里·加加林乘坐东方一号进入外层空间，完成世界上首次载人太空飞行。
text.en: Aboard Vostok 1, Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin performed the first human spaceflight, completing one orbit of Earth in 108 minutes.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国作曲家乔治·弗里德里希·亨德尔的清唱剧《弥赛亚》在爱尔兰都柏林首演。
text.en: The first performance of the oratorio Messiah by George Frideric Handel took place in Dublin.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美利坚联盟国支持者约翰·布斯在福特剧院开枪刺杀美国总统亚伯拉罕·林肯。
text.en: Actor and Confederate sympathizer John Wilkes Booth fatally shot U.S. president Abraham Lincoln at Ford's Theatre in Washington, D.C.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.en: A Dictionary of the English Language

text.zh-CN: 塞缪尔·约翰逊编纂的《英语词典》首次出版。
text.en: Samuel Johnson's A Dictionary of the English Language was first published.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 俄罗斯革命家弗拉迪米尔·列宁从瑞士返回彼得格勒，并领导布尔什维克革命。
text.en: Vladimir Lenin returned from exile to Petrograd.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 威尼斯共和国维罗纳爆发反对法兰西共和国军队的反抗行动，但最终失败。
text.en: An uprising against French troops began in Verona, then part of the Venetian Republic.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在光荣革命期间，波士顿殖民地居民发起反抗新英格兰自治领的起义行动。
text.en: Glorious Revolution: Provincial militia and citizens in Boston revolted, arresting officials of the Dominion of New England.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 欧洲多个国家在英国签署《伦敦条约》，承认比利时从荷兰联合王国正式独立。
text.en: European powers signed the Treaty of London, recognizing Belgium's independence.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国化学家路易·巴斯德和生理学家克洛德·贝尔纳完成首次巴氏消毒法实验。
text.en: Louis Pasteur and Claude Bernard completed an early pasteurization experiment.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 巴西政府将首都从里约热内卢迁往由建筑师卢西奥·科斯塔规划的新市镇巴西利亚。
text.en: Brasília, a planned city primarily designed by architect and urban planner Lúcio Costa, was officially inaugurated, replacing Rio de Janeiro as the capital of Brazil.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国军队在第二次伊珀尔战役使用氯气攻击协约国联军，为首次大规模化学武器攻击。
text.en: German forces used chlorine gas on a large scale during the Second Battle of Ypres.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 爱尔兰物理学家威廉·哈密顿发表论文《光线系统理论》，建立光学的数学理论。
text.en: William Rowan Hamilton presented his Theory of Systems of Rays, developing a mathematical theory of optics.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国发现号航天飞机在甘迺迪太空中心发射升空，将哈勃空间望远镜送入地球轨道。
text.en: The Hubble Space Telescope launched aboard the Space Shuttle Discovery.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 民变领袖李自成率领大顺军队攻入北京城并迫使崇祯帝在景山自缢，明朝灭亡。
text.en: Ming–Qing transition: The Ming dynasty of China fell when the Chongzhen Emperor committed suicide during a peasant rebellion led by Li Zicheng.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国陆军士兵在弗吉尼亚州开枪击毙刺杀总统亚伯拉罕·林肯的枪手约翰·布斯。
text.en: U.S. Army soldiers cornered and fatally shot John Wilkes Booth, the assassin of U.S. president Abraham Lincoln, ending a twelve-day manhunt.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国作曲家路德维希·范·贝多芬创作a小调回旋曲《致爱丽丝》，但未公开发表。
text.en: Ludwig van Beethoven composed his Bagatelle No. 25 in A minor, better known as "Für Elise" , one of his most popular compositions.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国企业家丹尼斯·蒂托搭乘联盟TM-32前往国际空间站，成为第一位太空游客。
text.en: Dennis Tito launched aboard Soyuz TM-32, becoming the first paying space tourist.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国探险家詹姆斯·库克指挥的努力号三桅帆船抵达植物学湾，并首次登陆澳大利亚。
text.en: On his first voyage, British explorer James Cook and the crew of HMS Endeavour landed at Botany Bay, making the first recorded European landfall on the eastern coast of Australia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在经总统选举当选后，乔治·华盛顿在美国纽约联邦国家纪念堂宣誓就任首任美国总统。
text.en: George Washington took the oath of office as the first president of the United States at Federal Hall in New York City.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在《1707年联合法令》生效后，英格兰王国和苏格兰王国合并为大不列颠王国。
text.en: Under the terms of the Acts of Union, the Kingdoms of England and Scotland merged to form the Kingdom of Great Britain, with a single parliament and government based in Westminster.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国海军特种作战开发群在巴基斯坦阿伯塔巴德成功击毙恐怖分子奥萨马·本·拉登。
text.en: Osama bin Laden was killed by U.S. Navy SEAL Team Six in his private residential compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 波兰立陶宛联邦的四年议会正式通过《五三宪法》，这也是欧洲第一部法典化的宪法。
text.en: The Great Sejm of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth ratified the first codified national constitution in Europe.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 北京学生集会游行，抗议巴黎和会对山东问题的处理，五四运动爆发。
text.en: Students demonstrated in Beijing against the Paris Peace Conference settlement over Shandong, beginning the May Fourth Movement.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 艾伦·谢泼德完成亚轨道飞行，成为首位进入太空的美国人。
text.en: Alan Shepard completed a suborbital flight, becoming the first American in space.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在历经长达6年的兴建后，横穿英吉利海峡、连接英国和法国的英法海底隧道正式通车。
text.en: The Channel Tunnel between Britain and France was officially opened.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔要求国民公会确立最高主宰崇拜 为法兰西第一共和国的国教。
text.en: French Revolution: Maximilien Robespierre established the Cult of the Supreme Being as the new state religion of the French First Republic.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 联合抵制1984年夏季奥运会

text.zh-CN: 苏联、东德、波兰等社会主义国家宣布不参加在美国洛杉矶举行的夏季奥林匹克运动会。
text.en: The Soviet Union announced the boycott of the Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, citing security concerns.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.en: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia

text.zh-CN: 罗马尼亚外交部部长米哈伊尔·科格尔尼恰努在议会宣布罗马尼亚正式脱离奥斯曼帝国独立。
text.en: Romania's foreign minister proclaimed independence from the Ottoman Empire in parliament.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 非洲人国民大会领导人纳尔逊·曼德拉在先前大选胜出后，宣誓就任南非首位黑人总统。
text.en: Nelson Mandela was inaugurated as South Africa's first black president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国商人约翰·贝林罕在下议院击毙首相斯宾塞·珀西瓦尔，使其为唯一一位遭暗杀身亡的英国首相。
text.en: Spencer Perceval was shot in the lobby of the House of Commons, becoming the only British prime minister to be assassinated.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 日本借口八瑶湾事件出兵攻打台湾南部原住民部落，为日本明治维新后首次对外用兵。
text.en: Japan began its military expedition against indigenous communities in southern Taiwan.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 巴西皇储伊莎贝尔签署《黄金法》，废除巴西的奴隶制度。
text.en: Princess Isabel signed the Golden Law abolishing slavery in Brazil.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联、波兰等8个东方集团国家成立华沙条约组织，用来对抗北大西洋公约组织。
text.en: Cold War: Eight Eastern Bloc countries signed a mutual defense treaty to establish the Warsaw Pact.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 巴拉圭宣布脱离西班牙帝国在拉普拉塔总督辖区的殖民统治，并开始推动独立工作。
text.en: Paraguay achieved independence from Spanish colonial rule.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国电影艺术与科学学院在加利福尼亚州好莱坞举行第一届奥斯卡金像奖的颁奖典礼。
text.en: The first Academy Awards ceremony was held in Hollywood, California.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 扎伊尔叛军首领洛朗·卡比拉自立为总统并恢复国名为刚果民主共和国，第一次刚果战争结束。
text.en: The First Congo War came to an end when Laurent-Désiré Kabila proclaimed himself president of Zaire, which was also renamed the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: India conducted its first nuclear test explosion at Pokhran, the first confirmed nuclear test by a nation outside the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.

text.en: Napoleon Bonaparte established the Legion of Honour to recognize military and civilian service.

text.en: A research team including Luc Montagnier published a report on the isolation of the virus later known as HIV.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Montenegro held a referendum in which voters supported independence from Serbia and Montenegro.

text.zh-CN: 锡兰通过建立共和国的新宪法，改名为斯里兰卡。
text.en: Ceylon adopted a republican constitution and changed its name to Sri Lanka.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 阿斯特图书馆与莱诺克斯图书馆同意合并，组建纽约公共图书馆。
text.en: The Astor and Lenox libraries agreed to merge to form the New York Public Library.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 连接美国纽约曼哈顿和布鲁克林的布鲁克林大桥正式通车，为当时世界上最长的悬索桥。
text.en: New York City's Brooklyn Bridge opened as the longest suspension bridge in the world at the time.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: The Constitutional Convention met in Philadelphia with the intention of revising the Articles of Confederation of the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联领导人列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫和美国总统理查德·尼克松在莫斯科签署《反弹道飞弹条约》。
text.en: The United States and Soviet Union signed the Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty in Moscow.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国旧金山金门大桥向行人开放。
text.en: San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge opened to pedestrians.

text.en: Nepal's constituent assembly abolished the monarchy and declared a republic.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 新西兰登山家艾德蒙·希拉里和尼泊尔登山家丹增诺盖成为首批登上珠穆朗玛峰峰顶的团队。
text.en: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first confirmed climbers to reach Mount Everest's summit.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: The Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C., featuring a sculpture of the sixteenth U.S. president Abraham Lincoln by Daniel Chester French, opened.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: The Union of South Africa became the Republic of South Africa.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: King Birendra and several members of Nepal's royal family were killed at the royal palace in Kathmandu.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 载有欧洲空间局火星探测器火星快车号的俄罗斯联盟号运载火箭自哈萨克发射升空。
text.en: The European Space Agency's Mars Express mission launched from Kazakhstan.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 已经退位的前英国国王爱德华八世与美国名流沃利斯·辛普森在法国图尔举行婚礼。
text.en: Half a year after abdicating the British throne, Edward, Duke of Windsor, married American socialite Wallis Simpson in a private ceremony in France.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Élisabeth Thible became the first woman to fly in an untethered hot-air balloon.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国务卿乔治·马歇尔在哈佛大学发表演讲，提出帮助欧洲战后重建的马歇尔计划。
text.en: At a speech at Harvard University, United States Secretary of State George Marshall called for economic aid to war-torn Europe, outlining a recovery program that became known as the Marshall Plan.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国牛津大学下辖的阿什莫林博物馆正式开放，被公认是英语世界中首个大学博物馆。
text.en: The Ashmolean Museum opened at the University of Oxford.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: The Lateran Treaty was ratified to bring Vatican City into existence, thus ending the "Roman question".

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国左派作家乔治·奥威尔创作的经典反乌托邦小说《一九八四》在伦敦首次出版。
text.en: Nineteen Eighty-Four, a dystopian political novel by the English writer George Orwell about life under a fictional totalitarian government, was published.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 北大西洋公约组织和南斯拉夫联盟共和国签署和平条约，科索沃战争宣告结束。
text.en: Yugoslav Wars: The Kumanovo Agreement was signed, bringing an end to the Kosovo War the next day.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 为了报复舍门将军号事件，美国远征舰队登陆并占领江华岛数个朝鲜王朝堡垒。
text.en: U.S. forces attacked Korean fortifications on Ganghwa Island.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国亚拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士站立于亚拉巴马大学礼堂门口，试图阻止非裔学生入学。
text.en: The University of Alabama was desegregated as Governor George Wallace stepped aside after defiantly blocking the entrance to an auditorium.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在纳粹德国占领下的荷兰阿姆斯特丹生活的犹太人女孩安妮·法兰克开始撰写她的日记。
text.en: On her thirteenth birthday, Anne Frank began keeping a diary during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands in World War II.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国空间探测器先驱者10号越过海王星轨道，成为第一个飞越太阳系行星轨道的人造物体。
text.en: Pioneer 10 passed the orbit of Neptune, becoming the first man-made object to leave the proximity of the major planets of the Solar System.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: The Second Continental Congress adopted the stars and stripes design for the flag of the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: French physician Jean-Baptiste Denys transfused sheep blood into a human patient.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Aboard Vostok 6, Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman in space.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国共和党人员潜入华盛顿哥伦比亚特区水门综合大厦的民主党办公室时被捕，水门事件爆发。
text.en: Five men were arrested for attempted burglary on the offices of the Democratic National Committee, igniting the Watergate scandal that ultimately led to the resignation of US president Richard Nixon more than two years later.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 自由军官领导人穆罕默德·纳吉布宣布埃及废除君主制，并由其担任第一任埃及总统。
text.en: Egypt abolished its monarchy and became a republic, with Muhammad Naguib as president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Kuwait became independent of British protection.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 亚历山德丽娜·维多利亚在英国国王威廉四世逝世后继任王位，展开长达63年的统治。
text.en: Queen Victoria acceded to the British throne, beginning a 63-year reign.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国工程师伯特·鲁坦设计的太空船1号成为首部私人研制且进入次轨道的载人航天器。
text.en: SpaceShipOne completed a privately funded crewed suborbital spaceflight.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国天文学家詹姆斯·克里斯蒂在海军天文台检查冥王星的照片时，发现其卫星「冥卫一」。
text.en: Astronomer James Christy discovered Pluto's moon Charon while examining photographs.

title.en: 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum

text.zh-CN: 英国举行有关欧洲联盟成员资格的公民投票，最终有51.9％的选民投票支持脱离欧洲联盟。
text.en: Citizens of the United Kingdom voted in favour of leaving the European Union.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 暹罗立宪派人士和军人发动不流血的立宪革命，结束拉达那哥欣王国的君主专制。
text.en: A group of military officers and civilians engineered a bloodless coup in Siam, ending the absolute rule of the Chakri dynasty.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在《爱尔兰宪法》生效后，爱尔兰大学教授道格拉斯·海德正式就任首届爱尔兰总统。
text.en: Douglas Hyde took office as the first president of Ireland.

text.zh-CN: 各国代表在美国旧金山签署《联合国宪章》。
text.en: Representatives signed the United Nations Charter in San Francisco.

items.source: United Nations

text.zh-CN: 在俄国革命期间，俄罗斯帝国海军黑海舰队的波将金号战列舰水兵发起暴动。
text.en: First Russian Revolution: The crew of the Russian battleship Potemkin began a mutiny against their officers.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg, were assassinated in Sarajevo by Gavrilo Princip, a Yugoslav nationalist, sparking the outbreak of World War I.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Seychelles became independent of Britain and joined the Commonwealth.

text.en: Einstein submitted On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies, setting out special relativity.

text.en: Warsaw Pact member states signed a protocol formally dissolving the organization.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统林顿·约翰逊签署《民权法案》，禁止学校、工作场所和公共空间的种族隔离。
text.en: The Civil Rights Act was signed into law, outlawing segregation in schools, at the workplace, and other facilities that served the general public in the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在公民投票通过后，法国总统夏尔·戴高乐宣布正式承认阿尔及利亚为独立国家。
text.en: France formally recognized Algerian independence following a referendum.

text.en: In Philadelphia, the Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence, announcing that the thirteen American colonies were no longer a part of the British Empire.

text.en: Isaac Newton's Principia was published, setting out his laws of motion and universal gravitation.

text.en: Nyasaland became the independent country of Malawi.

text.en: U.S. president William McKinley signed the Newlands Resolution providing for the annexation of Hawaii.

text.en: The United States Declaration of Independence received its first formal public reading in Philadelphia.

text.zh-CN: 在南苏丹独立公投确认通过后，南苏丹共和国宣布正式脱离苏丹共和国独立。
text.en: South Sudan became independent following a referendum.

text.en: The Telstar 1 communications satellite was launched from Cape Canaveral.

text.en: To Kill a Mockingbird, a novel by Harper Lee featuring themes of racial injustice and the loss of innocence in the Deep South of America, was published.

text.zh-CN: 太平洋西部吉尔伯特群岛正式脱离英国统治而独立，国名定为吉里巴斯共和国。
text.en: The Gilbert Islands became independent of Britain as the Republic of Kiribati.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 乌拉圭蒙得维的亚举行第一届国际足联世界杯开幕式，来自美洲和欧洲的13支球队参赛。
text.en: The first FIFA World Cup was opened in Uruguay.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国巴黎的市民攻陷被视为旧制度象征的巴士底狱，法国大革命爆发。
text.en: The Bastille, a fortress and prison in Paris, was stormed by a crowd during the flashpoint of the French Revolution.

text.zh-CN: 法国军队在埃及港口城市罗塞塔发现罗塞塔石碑，成为后来破译古埃及圣书体的关键。
text.en: French soldiers at Fort Julien, near the Egyptian port city of Rashid, uncovered the Rosetta Stone, which was essential in the decipherment of ancient Egyptian scripts.

text.en: NASA launched Apollo 11 from Kennedy Space Center.

text.en: Russian Revolution: Tsar Nicholas II and his family were murdered by Bolsheviks at Yekaterinburg.

text.zh-CN: 驻守西属摩洛哥的国民军发动反对西班牙第二共和国政府的叛乱行动，西班牙内战爆发。
text.en: Nationalist rebels attempted a coup against the Second Spanish Republic, sparking the Spanish Civil War.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Aung San and members of Burma's interim cabinet were assassinated in Rangoon.

text.en: The first International Mathematical Olympiad began in Romania.

text.en: Eiichiro Oda's manga One Piece began serialization in Weekly Shōnen Jump.

text.en: Alan Hale and Thomas Bopp independently discovered Comet Hale–Bopp.

text.en: Brigham Young led the first group of Mormon pioneers into the Salt Lake Valley of Utah, at the time a part of Mexico.

title.en: Fall of the Fascist regime in Italy

text.zh-CN: 意大利法西斯大委员会解除贝尼托·墨索里尼的政府职务，由佩特罗·巴多格里奥继任首相。
text.en: The Grand Council of Fascism voted a motion of no confidence against Benito Mussolini, who was arrested the same day by King Victor Emmanuel III and replaced by Pietro Badoglio.

text.zh-CN: 德国作曲家理查德·瓦格纳创作的歌剧《帕西法尔》在巴伐利亚王国拜律特节日剧院首次演出。
text.en: Richard Wagner's opera Parsifal premiered at the Bayreuth Festival Theatre.

text.zh-CN: 朝鲜战争参战方在板门店签署停战协定。
text.en: The Korean Armistice Agreement was signed at Panmunjom.

text.zh-CN: 阿根廷将军何塞·德·圣马丁宣布秘鲁自西班牙帝国独立，并与西门·玻利瓦尔领导独立战争。
text.en: José de San Martín proclaimed Peru's independence from Spain.

text.zh-CN: 日本江户幕府与美国驻日公使汤森·哈里斯签订《美日修好通商条约》，其后数月亦陆续与荷兰、俄罗斯、英国、法国签订类似的不平等条约。
text.en: Japan's Tokugawa shogunate and the United States signed the Treaty of Amity and Commerce.

text.zh-CN: 阿波罗15号的斯科特和艾尔文乘登月舱在月球着陆。
text.en: Apollo 15 astronauts Scott and Irwin landed on the Moon.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 第一阶段削减战略武器条约

text.zh-CN: 美国和苏联签署《第一阶段削减战略武器条约》，为历史上规模最大的军备控制条约。
text.en: The United States and Soviet Union signed the START I nuclear arms-reduction treaty.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 约瑟夫·普利斯特里在加热氧化汞时分离出氧气。
text.en: Joseph Priestley isolated oxygen by heating mercury oxide.

text.zh-CN: 美国物理学家卡尔·戴维·安德森在加州理工学院发现正电子，证实反物质的存在。
text.en: At the California Institute of Technology, American physicist Carl David Anderson proved the existence of antimatter with the discovery of the positron, for which he would receive the 1936 Nobel Prize in Physics.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法兰西共同体成员国尼日尔宣布从法国获得完全独立，哈马尼·迪奥里担任首任总统。
text.en: Niger became fully independent of France, with Hamani Diori as president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德意志帝国开始入侵作为中立国的比利时，大英帝国依据《伦敦条约》向德国宣战。
text.en: World War I: Adhering to the terms of the Treaty of London, the United Kingdom declared war on Germany in response to the latter's invasion of Belgium.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天局发射前往木星的朱诺号探测器。
text.en: NASA launched the Juno spacecraft toward Jupiter.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天局火星科学实验室辖下的火星车「好奇号」成功降落火星盖尔撞击坑。
text.en: NASA's Curiosity rover landed in Gale Crater on Mars.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国海军陆战队派遣部队登陆瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、图拉吉岛等岛屿，瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役爆发。
text.en: World War II: U.S. Marines initiated the first American offensive of the Guadalcanal campaign, with landings on Tulagi, Gavutu–Tanambogo and Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 作为当时世界最高结构物的波兰华沙电台广播塔因为替换拉索出现错误而倒塌。
text.en: The Warsaw radio mast, then the tallest structure ever built, at 646.38 metres (2,120.7 ft), collapsed due to an error in exchanging the guys on the highest telecommunications equipment of the mast.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统理查德·尼克松的辞职生效，杰拉尔德·福特继任总统。
text.en: Richard Nixon's resignation took effect, and Gerald Ford became U.S. president.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国政府决定将巴黎的卢浮宫作为博物馆向公众开放，后来成为参观人数最多的艺术博物馆。
text.en: The Louvre opened to the public as a museum in Paris.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国殖民者弗朗西斯·莱特在马来西亚槟岛建立殖民地乔治市，展开对英属马来亚的统治。
text.en: Francis Light founded George Town, the first British settlement in Southeast Asia and the present-day capital of the Malaysian state of Penang.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国天文学家阿萨夫·霍尔在美国海军天文台发现火星较小的卫星「火卫二」。
text.en: Astronomer Asaph Hall discovered Deimos, the smaller of Mars's two moons.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在西班牙王位继承战争期间，约翰·丘吉尔的奥格斯堡同盟联军在布伦汉姆战役取得关键胜利。
text.en: War of the Spanish Succession: The Duke of Marlborough led Allied forces to a crucial victory at the Battle of Blenheim.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福和英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔在纽芬兰自治领发表《大西洋宪章》。
text.en: After a secret meeting in Newfoundland, British prime minister Winston Churchill and U.S. president Franklin D. Roosevelt issued the Atlantic Charter, establishing a vision for a post–World War II world.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国纽约州举行摇滚音乐节伍德斯托克音乐节，此为世界上规模最大的嬉皮士聚会。
text.en: The Woodstock music festival began in New York State.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 由于探险队在加拿大育空地区道森市附近发现黄金，引起克朗代克淘金热的风潮。
text.en: A group including George Carmack and Skookum Jim Mason discovered gold near Dawson City, Canada, setting off the Klondike Gold Rush.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏加诺和穆罕默德·哈达宣布印度尼西亚从荷兰独立，其后与荷兰帝国爆发战争。
text.en: Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaimed Indonesian independence.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国天文学家阿萨夫·霍尔在美国海军天文台发现火星较大的卫星「火卫一」。
text.en: American astronomer Asaph Hall discovered Phobos, the larger of Mars's two moons, six days after discovering Deimos, the smaller one.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 坦波夫省农民发动坦波夫起义，反对苏俄的布尔什维克政府。
text.en: Russian Civil War: Peasants in Tambov Governorate began a rebellion against the Bolshevik government of Soviet Russia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天局太空探测器旅行者2号自佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地升空。
text.en: NASA launched the Voyager 2 space probe from Cape Canaveral.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国巴黎卢浮宫收藏的列奥纳多·达·芬奇油画作品《蒙娜丽莎》遭博物馆职员窃走。
text.en: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre by museum employee Vincenzo Peruggia and was not recovered until two years later.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在红十字国际委员会创始人亨利·杜南倡导下，12个国家在瑞士签署《日内瓦第一公约》。
text.en: Under the leadership of Henry Dunant and the International Committee of the Red Cross, twelve European states signed the First Geneva Convention, establishing rules for the protection of victims of armed conflict.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联和纳粹德国在莫斯科签署《苏德互不侵犯条约》，协议瓜分波罗的海国家和东欧。
text.en: Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, a ten-year mutual non-aggression treaty, which also secretly divided northern and eastern Europe into German and Soviet spheres of influence.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 国际天文学联合会的行星定义

text.zh-CN: 国际天文学联合会通过新的行星定义决议，冥王星的地位由太阳系行星降级成为矮行星。
text.en: The International Astronomical Union passed a resolution redefining the term planet and classifying Pluto as a dwarf planet.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国国家航空航天局的旅行者1号成为首个穿越日球层顶并进入星际物质的探测器。
text.en: The NASA space probe Voyager 1 became the first man-made object to enter interstellar space.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.en: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen

text.zh-CN: 法国国民制宪议会在凡尔赛宫表决通过《人权和公民权宣言》，宣布自由、财产、安全和反抗压迫的权利是天赋人权。
text.en: French Revolution: The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen, defining a set of individual and collective rights of the people, was approved by the National Constituent Assembly.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 威廉·豪率领的英国军队在长岛会战中击败乔治·华盛顿领导的大陆军。
text.en: British forces led by William Howe defeated the Continental Army under George Washington at the Battle of Long Island, the largest battle of the American Revolutionary War.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 非裔美国人民权运动领袖马丁·路德·金在林肯纪念堂发表著名演讲《我有一个梦想》。
text.en: American civil-rights leader Martin Luther King Jr. delivered the speech "I Have a Dream" during the March on Washington, calling for civil and economic rights and an end to racism in the United States.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 清朝与英国代表签署《南京条约》结束第一次鸦片战争，香港割让给英国并开放五口通商。
text.en: Under the Treaty of Nanking, an "unequal treaty" that ended the First Opium War, the Chinese island from which Hong Kong would grow was ceded to Britain.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 东帝汶在联合国主持下就独立问题举行独立公投，最终决定从印度尼西亚独立。
text.en: East Timor held a UN-supervised referendum in which voters chose independence from Indonesia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 威尔士王妃戴安娜之死
title.en: Death of Diana, Princess of Wales

text.zh-CN: 英国威尔士王妃戴安娜和男友多迪·法耶兹在法国巴黎阿尔马桥隧道内发生车祸逝世。
text.en: Diana, Princess of Wales, her partner Dodi Fayed, and their driver were killed in a car crash in Paris.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纳粹德国军队自维隆和西盘半岛发动大型攻势入侵波兰，第二次世界大战在欧洲爆发。
text.en: German forces attacked multiple locations in Poland, including Wieluń and Westerplatte, starting World War II in Europe.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国首都伦敦发生该城市历史上最为严重的火灾，其中旧圣保罗座堂等大片建筑遭到烧毁。
text.en: A large fire began in London's Pudding Lane and burned for five days, destroying St Paul's Cathedral and the homes of 70,000 of the city's 80,000 inhabitants.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国国王乔治三世的代表和美国代表在法国巴黎签订《巴黎条约》，美国独立战争宣告结束。
text.en: Britain and the United States signed the Treaty of Paris, ending the American Revolutionary War.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 新西兰坎特伯雷地区发生7.1级地震。
text.en: A magnitude-7.1 earthquake struck New Zealand's Canterbury region.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 为了对抗英国议会通过不可容忍法令，12个北美洲殖民地代表在费城木匠厅召开大陆会议。
text.en: Delegates from twelve North American colonies met in Philadelphia for the First Continental Congress.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统威廉·麦金莱在泛美博览会遭到无政府主义者里昂·乔戈什暗杀，并在8天后逝世。
text.en: U.S. president William McKinley was fatally shot by anarchist Leon Czolgosz at the Pan-American Exposition in Buffalo, New York, and died eight days later.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在八国联军占领北京城的情况下，清朝政府和英国、美国等11个国家签订《辛丑条约》。
text.en: With Beijing occupied by foreign troops from the Eight-Nation Alliance, Qing China was forced to sign the Boxer Protocol, an unequal treaty that ended the Boxer Rebellion.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.en: Death and state funeral of Elizabeth II

text.zh-CN: 英国女王暨大英国协王国君主伊莉莎白二世在苏格兰巴摩拉城堡因病逝世，其子查尔斯三世继位。
text.en: Queen Elizabeth II died at Balmoral Castle; Charles III succeeded her.

title.zh-CN: 伯尔尼保护文学和艺术作品公约

text.zh-CN: 瑞士、英国等10个国家在伯恩签订关于著作权保护的《伯恩保护文学和艺术作品公约》。
text.en: Ten countries signed the Berne Convention for the protection of literary and artistic works.

text.zh-CN: 欧洲核子研究中心在瑞士日内瓦的大型强子对撞机测试运转，为世界上最大的粒子加速器。
text.en: The Large Hadron Collider at CERN circulated its first proton beam.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 基地组织在美国发动劫机恐怖袭击，造成大量人员死亡。
text.en: Al-Qaeda carried out hijackings and terrorist attacks in the United States, killing thousands.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 奥地利作曲家古斯塔夫·马勒的《第8号交响曲》首次演出，为规模最大的古典音乐曲目之一。
text.en: Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8, one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and popularly known as the "Symphony of a Thousand", was first performed in Munich.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 以色列与巴勒斯坦解放组织的代表在华盛顿签署《奥斯陆协议》。
text.en: Representatives of Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization signed the Oslo Accords in Washington.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 激光干涉引力波天文台LIGO首次直接探测到引力波。
text.en: LIGO made the first direct detection of gravitational waves.

items.source: LIGO Laboratory / Caltech

title.zh-CN: 利物浦和曼彻斯特铁路

text.zh-CN: 连接英国利物浦与曼彻斯特之间的铁路正式通车，为世界上首条完全使用蒸汽动力的铁路。
text.en: The Liverpool and Manchester Railway opened between the two English cities.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国太空公司SpaceX发射灵感4号，为世界上首个全部由平民执行的宇宙轨道飞行任务。
text.en: SpaceX launched Inspiration4, the first orbital spaceflight with an entirely civilian crew.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 近一千名示威者在美国宪法日进入纽约金融中心华尔街示威，拉开了占领华尔街运动的序幕。
text.en: Adbusters, a Canadian anti-consumerist publication, organized a protest against corporate influence on democracy at Zuccotti Park in New York City that became known as Occupy Wall Street.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 联合国秘书长达格·哈马舍尔德之座机于北罗德西亚坠毁，机上16人全数罹难。
text.en: An aircraft crashed near Ndola in Northern Rhodesia, resulting in the deaths of 16 people, including United Nations secretary-general Dag Hammarskjöld.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 阿塞拜疆在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区发动军事行动。
text.en: Azerbaijan launched a military offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 首部《中华人民共和国宪法》在首届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上获得审议通过。
text.en: China's First National People's Congress adopted the country's first constitution.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国作家J·R·R·托尔金的奇幻小说《霍比特人》首次出版，也是后来《指环王》前传。
text.en: J. R. R. Tolkien's The Hobbit was first published.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 威廉·Z·福斯特领导逾36万名美国钢铁员工发动罢工，要求实现8小时工作制、每周工作六天并改善劳工待遇。
text.en: A major steelworkers' strike began in the United States, seeking shorter hours and improved conditions.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国共和党副总统候选人理查德·尼克松在电视上发表跳棋演讲，这是政治家借助电视吸引民众的一个重要先河。
text.en: U.S. vice-presidential candidate Richard Nixon delivered the Checkers speech, one of the first political uses of television to appeal directly to the populace.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 沃伦委员会向总统林登·约翰逊提交《沃伦报告》，称李·哈维·奥斯瓦尔德独自一人刺杀前美国总统约翰·甘迺迪。
text.en: The Warren Commission released its report to the U.S. president, concluding that Lee Harvey Oswald acted alone in the assassination of John F. Kennedy.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国加利福尼亚州的红杉国家公园成立，以保护巨杉林。
text.en: Sequoia National Park was established in California to protect giant sequoia trees.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 中华民国将赵元任等创制的国语罗马字作为中文拉丁化的正式方案。
text.en: The Republic of China adopted Gwoyeu Romatzyh as the official system for romanization of Mandarin Chinese.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国历史学家商博良在对法兰西文学院的演说中宣布破解罗塞塔石碑，埃及象形文沉寂千年之后再度得到破译。
text.en: In a letter to the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres in Paris, Jean-François Champollion announced his initial successes in deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs on the Rosetta Stone.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏格兰药学家亚历山大·弗莱明发现青霉菌具有杀菌作用，促成往后青霉素提炼研究。
text.en: Scottish biologist and pharmacologist Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin when he noticed a bacteria-killing mould growing in his laboratory.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 协约国在百日攻势中突破德军兴登堡防线，德国最高陆军司令部向德皇威廉二世和政府请求和谈。
text.en: World War I: The Battle of St Quentin Canal took place, which led to the British Fourth Army making the first breach of the German defensive Hindenburg Line.

text.zh-CN: 纳粹德国、法西斯意大利与英国、法国缔结《慕尼黑协定》，英国首相张伯伦宣称其带来了「我们时代的和平」。
text.en: Adolf Hitler, Benito Mussolini, Neville Chamberlain, and Édouard Daladier signed the Munich Agreement, stipulating that Czechoslovakia must cede the Sudetenland to Germany.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 日本东京与大阪之间的东海道新干线通车，为世界首条商业营运的高速铁路系统。
text.en: Japan opened the Tōkaidō Shinkansen high-speed railway between Tokyo and Osaka.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 墨西哥军队与德克萨斯民兵在墨属德克萨斯冈萨雷斯发生冲突，德克萨斯革命爆发。
text.en: Mexican dragoons dispatched to disarm settlers at Gonzales in Mexican Texas encountered stiff resistance from a Texian militia at the Battle of Gonzales, the first armed engagement of the Texas Revolution.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国在澳洲西澳洲成功试爆首枚原子弹，成为第三个拥有核武器的国家。
text.en: The United Kingdom successfully conducted its first nuclear test, becoming the world's third state with nuclear weapons.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 苏联斯普特尼克1号在拜科努尔航天发射场发射升空，为首颗绕地球运行的人造卫星。
text.en: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 詹姆斯·邦德系列电影首部电影《诺博士》在英国上映，披头士乐队也在英国发行首张单曲《Love Me Do》。
text.en: Dr. No, the first James Bond film, was released.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 中共中央第一副主席、国务院总理华国锋下令逮捕四人帮主要成员，历时十年的文化大革命宣告结束。
text.en: The Gang of Four were arrested in China, marking the end of the Cultural Revolution.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 巴勒斯坦武装团体哈马斯自加沙地带对以色列发动大规模军事袭击，以色列随即对哈马斯宣战，加沙战争爆发。
text.en: In the October 7 attacks, Hamas and other Palestinian militant groups killed nearly 1,200 people in southern Israel and took 251 hostages, starting the Gaza war.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 支持马克思主义的拉丁美洲游击战领导人切·格瓦拉在玻利维亚拉伊格拉遭到俘获，次日遭枪决身亡。
text.en: Marxist revolutionary and guerrilla leader Che Guevara was captured near La Higuera, Bolivia.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 22国在瑞士签署《伯尔尼条约》以协调跨国邮政业务，万国邮政联盟由此诞生。
text.en: The Universal Postal Union, then known as the General Postal Union, was established with the signing of the Treaty of Bern to unify disparate postal services and regulations so that international mail could be exchanged easily.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 中国革命组织文学社和共进会发动武昌起义，随后扩大为试图推翻清朝统治的辛亥革命。
text.en: The Xinhai Revolution began with the Wuchang Uprising, marking the beginning of the collapse of the Qing dynasty and the establishment of the Republic of China.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 牙买加的黑人因为判决不公与英国殖民当局爆发暴力冲突，愤怒的黑人焚烧了法院和附近的建筑物。
text.en: The Morant Bay rebellion, led by Paul Bogle and George William Gordon, began in Jamaica; after protestors burned down the courthouse, it was brutally suppressed by Governor Edward John Eyre.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 波士顿儿童医院首次使用铁肺呼吸机，治疗一名因脊髓灰质炎瘫痪的儿童。
text.en: An iron lung was first used at Boston Children's Hospital to treat a child with polio.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国天文学家夏尔·梅西耶发现涡状星系。
text.en: French astronomer Charles Messier discovered the Whirlpool Galaxy.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫在向尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫发动政变后，继任成为苏联共产党中央委员会第一书记。
text.en: Members of the Politburo voted to remove Nikita Khrushchev as First Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and replace him with Leonid Brezhnev.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 载有杨利伟的神舟五号自酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空，为中国第一艘载人航天飞船。
text.en: China launched Shenzhou 5 with Yang Liwei aboard, its first crewed space mission.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 洛伊·O·迪士尼与华特·迪士尼在美国好莱坞创立动画工作室华特迪士尼公司。
text.en: Roy and Walt Disney founded the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio in Hollywood, which eventually grew to become one of the largest media and entertainment corporations in the world.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 首届英国高尔夫球公开赛于苏格兰普雷斯特威克高尔夫俱乐部举办，为高尔夫球四大满贯赛中历史最悠久的赛事。
text.en: The Open Championship, the oldest of the four major championships in men's golf, was first played at Prestwick Golf Club in Scotland.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 法国、英国、荷兰和奥地利签署《第二亚琛和约》，从而结束奥地利王位继承战争。
text.en: The War of the Austrian Succession ended with the signing of the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国物理学家马克斯·普朗克推论出普朗克黑体辐射定律，为现代物理学与量子力学先驱。
text.en: Max Planck presented a new formula for black-body radiation.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 依照《中苏友好同盟条约》换文之规定，蒙古人民共和国举行独立公投，其中100%的选票支持独立。
text.en: Mongolia held a referendum on independence.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 德国亚琛守军投降，亚琛战役结束。
text.en: German forces in Aachen surrendered, ending the Battle of Aachen.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 诺贝尔委员会宣布法国哲学家让-保罗·萨特获得诺贝尔文学奖，但之后他主动回绝奖项。
text.en: Jean-Paul Sartre was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, which he declined.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 越南国举行决定往后政体的公民投票，其中吴廷琰和保大帝分别主张采行共和制与君主制。
text.en: The State of Vietnam voted in a referendum to become a republic.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 英国天文学家拉塞尔发现天王星的卫星天卫一与天卫二。
text.en: Umbriel and Ariel, the third- and fourth-largest moons of Uranus, were discovered by William Lassell.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 乔治二世突然逝世后，22岁的乔治三世继位大不列颠国王和爱尔兰国王。
text.en: George III became King of Great Britain and Ireland, succeeding his grandfather George II.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 日本首任内阁总理大臣伊藤博文在哈尔滨火车站遭朝鲜独立运动人士安重根刺杀身亡。
text.en: Korean independence activist An Jung-geun assassinated former Japanese prime minister Itō Hirobumi in Harbin.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 在独立公投后，加泰罗尼亚单方面宣布脱离西班牙独立建国。西班牙政府指行为违宪，并根据《西班牙宪法》155条接管加泰罗尼亚、冻结自治权。
text.en: Catalonia's parliament declared independence; Spain invoked Article 155 to impose direct rule.

items.source: 维基百科贡献者 · Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 自由女神像举行落成典礼
title.en: Dedication of the Statue of Liberty

text.zh-CN: 自由女神像在纽约港举行落成典礼。这座由法国赠予美国的雕像由巴托尔迪设计，此前在法国建造，再拆卸运往纽约组装。
text.en: The Statue of Liberty was dedicated in New York Harbor. Designed by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi, the French gift had been built in France and shipped to New York in sections.

items.source: US National Park Service

text.zh-CN: 在巴达维亚举行的第二次青年大会通过青年誓言，主张共同的祖国、民族与统一语言。这份决议成为印度尼西亚民族运动的重要文献。
text.en: The Second Youth Congress in Batavia adopted a pledge affirming one homeland, one nation and a unifying language. It became an important document of Indonesian nationalism.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 赫鲁晓夫宣布撤除古巴导弹
title.en: Khrushchev announces missile withdrawal from Cuba

text.zh-CN: 赫鲁晓夫宣布同意拆除部署在古巴的苏联导弹，古巴导弹危机由此走向外交解决。导弹撤除安排逐步落实，美方海上封锁持续至11月20日。
text.en: Nikita Khrushchev announced agreement to remove Soviet missiles from Cuba, opening the way to a diplomatic settlement. The naval quarantine continued until November 20.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 捷克斯洛伐克宣布独立

text.zh-CN: 布拉格的民族委员会颁布建立独立捷克斯洛伐克国家的法律，脱离哈布斯堡王朝统治。10月28日后来成为纪念这一建国事件的日期。
text.en: The National Committee in Prague issued a law establishing an independent Czechoslovak state, ending Habsburg rule there. October 28 became the anniversary of its foundation.

items.source: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs

title.zh-CN: 美国国会推翻禁酒执法法案否决
title.en: Congress overrides the Volstead Act veto

text.zh-CN: 美国参议院继众议院之后推翻威尔逊总统对《沃尔斯特德法》的否决，使法案成为法律，为第十八修正案规定的禁酒提供执法细则。
text.en: The U.S. Senate joined the House in overriding President Woodrow Wilson's veto of the Volstead Act, making the enforcement legislation for Prohibition law.

items.source: United States Senate

title.zh-CN: 希腊拒绝意大利最后通牒

text.zh-CN: 希腊政府拒绝意大利要求其允许轴心国军队进入战略地点的最后通牒，意大利随后发动入侵。希腊以“说不日”纪念这一抵抗的开端。
text.en: Greece rejected Italy's ultimatum demanding access to strategic locations, and Italian forces invaded. The refusal is commemorated in Greece as Ohi Day.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 纽约证券交易所出现恐慌性抛售，股市大幅下跌。这一天被称为“黑色星期二”，是1929年华尔街股灾中具有代表性的交易日。
text.en: Panic selling drove a sharp fall on the New York Stock Exchange. Known as Black Tuesday, the session became an emblematic day of the 1929 Wall Street crash.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 按美国太平洋当地日期，加州大学洛杉矶分校向斯坦福研究所发送ARPANET首条主机间消息。原拟输入“login”，系统在收到前两个字母后中断。
text.en: On the local California date, UCLA sent the first ARPANET host-to-host message to the Stanford Research Institute. The intended command was login, but the connection failed after the first two letters.

items.source: Internet Society

title.zh-CN: 日内瓦会议通过红十字救护决议
title.en: Geneva conference adopts Red Cross resolutions

text.zh-CN: 日内瓦国际会议通过关于设立战地伤员救护团体、保护救护人员及采用白底红十字标志等决议，为红十字运动的发展奠定基础。
text.en: An international conference in Geneva adopted resolutions on relief societies for wounded soldiers, protection for medical personnel and a red cross on white as a common emblem.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.en: Proclamation of the Republic of Turkey

text.zh-CN: 土耳其大国民议会宣布建立共和国，穆斯塔法·凯末尔成为首任总统。10月29日此后被定为土耳其共和国日。
text.en: Turkey's Grand National Assembly proclaimed a republic, with Mustafa Kemal as its first president. The date is commemorated as Republic Day.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 苏伊士危机中的西奈进攻开始
title.en: Israel invades Sinai during the Suez Crisis

text.zh-CN: 以色列军队进攻埃及西奈半岛，苏伊士危机进入战争阶段。英国和法国随后加入对埃及的军事行动，冲突引起广泛国际反应。
text.en: Israeli forces invaded Egypt's Sinai Peninsula, beginning the fighting of the Suez Crisis. Britain and France joined the military action later.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 伽利略号飞掠加斯普拉

text.zh-CN: 伽利略号探测器在前往木星途中飞掠小行星加斯普拉，首次实现航天器对小行星的近距离探访，并拍摄其布满撞击坑的表面。
text.en: On its way to Jupiter, Galileo flew past Gaspra in the first spacecraft encounter with an asteroid. Its images revealed an irregular, heavily cratered body.

items.source: NASA

title.en: The War of the Worlds radio broadcast

text.zh-CN: 美国CBS广播网播出奥逊·威尔斯执导并讲述的《世界大战》广播剧，以模拟新闻播报的形式改编威尔斯的科幻小说。
text.en: CBS broadcast Orson Welles's radio adaptation of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds. Parts of the drama presented the fictional invasion through simulated news bulletins.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 中国青少年发展基金会在北京宣布实施希望工程，面向贫困地区失学少年募集助学资金，并支持改善乡村小学的办学条件。
text.en: The China Youth Development Foundation announced Project Hope in Beijing. The programme sought donations to help children in poor areas return to school and improve rural primary education.

items.source: 中国青年网

text.zh-CN: 伊斯坦布尔博斯普鲁斯大桥正式通车，通过公路连接城市分处欧洲和亚洲的两岸。这座悬索桥是横跨博斯普鲁斯海峡的第一座现代桥梁。
text.en: Istanbul's Bosphorus Bridge opened to road traffic between the European and Asian sides of the city. It was the first modern bridge across the strait.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 印度成为联合国创始会员国
title.en: India becomes an original UN member

text.zh-CN: 印度成为联合国创始会员国。它此前参加了旧金山会议并签署联合国宪章，当时仍处于英属统治之下，独立发生在两年之后。
text.en: India became an original member of the United Nations after participating in the San Francisco conference and signing the Charter. It was still under British rule and gained independence two years later.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.en: The Soviet Union tests Tsar Bomba

text.zh-CN: 苏联在新地岛上空试爆大当量热核装置“沙皇炸弹”，爆炸当量约为5000万吨TNT。这是冷战核武器试验史上的一次重大试验。
text.en: The Soviet Union detonated the thermonuclear device known as Tsar Bomba over Novaya Zemlya. Its yield of about 50 megatons made it a major event in Cold War nuclear testing.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 加拿大魁北克省举行第二次主权公投，询问选民是否支持在提出新伙伴关系后实现主权。反对一方以微弱多数获胜，魁北克留在加拿大。
text.en: Quebec voted in its second sovereignty referendum, which linked sovereignty to an offer of a new partnership with Canada. The No side won narrowly, and Quebec remained in Canada.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 以“城市，让生活更美好”为主题的上海世博会闭幕。本届世博会自5月1日开始，在黄浦江两岸集中展示各国的城市与社会发展构想。
text.en: Shanghai's World Expo closed after running from May 1. Held on both banks of the Huangpu River, it explored urban life under the theme Better City, Better Life.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 拉什莫尔山雕刻工程结束

text.zh-CN: 拉什莫尔山总统雕像工程被宣布完成，山体上留下华盛顿、杰斐逊、老罗斯福和林肯的头像。经费和战争形势使原先更宏大的方案未能实现。
text.en: The Mount Rushmore project was declared complete, leaving the heads of Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln. Funding limits and impending U.S. involvement in World War II had curtailed the original plan.

items.source: US National Park Service

title.zh-CN: 不列颠空战的英国官方终日
title.en: Britain's official end date for the Battle of Britain

text.zh-CN: 按照英国官方的战役分期，不列颠空战于这一天结束；德军对英国城市的夜间轰炸继续，伦敦大轰炸延续到1941年。
text.en: In Britain's official chronology, the Battle of Britain ended on this date. German night bombing continued, with the Blitz lasting into 1941.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 美国总统林肯发布公告，内华达正式加入联邦，成为美国第36个州。它是在南北战争期间获准建州的地区之一。
text.en: President Abraham Lincoln proclaimed Nevada's admission to the Union as the 36th U.S. state. Statehood came during the American Civil War.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 以逃脱表演闻名的魔术师哈里·胡迪尼在底特律逝世。他的舞台生涯以手铐、水箱等脱险节目著称，也是20世纪初大众娱乐史的一部分。
text.en: Harry Houdini, famed for his escape performances, died in Detroit. His handcuff and water-tank acts had made him a prominent figure in early twentieth-century popular entertainment.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.zh-CN: 印度总理英迪拉·甘地在新德里的官邸遭两名保镖枪击身亡。这起刺杀发生于同年印度军队在阿姆利则金庙实施军事行动之后。
text.en: Indian prime minister Indira Gandhi was shot dead by two of her bodyguards at her New Delhi residence. The assassination followed the army's operation at the Golden Temple earlier that year.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.en: The Maastricht Treaty enters into force

text.zh-CN: 《马斯特里赫特条约》正式生效，欧洲联盟据此成立，并为未来单一货币、共同外交以及司法和内政领域的合作提供框架。
text.en: The Maastricht Treaty entered into force, establishing the European Union and a framework for a future single currency, common foreign policy and cooperation in justice and home affairs.

items.source: European Union

title.zh-CN: 西斯廷礼拜堂新天顶画揭幕
title.en: The Sistine Chapel's new ceiling is inaugurated

text.zh-CN: 教皇尤利乌斯二世在诸圣节弥撒中为重新装饰的西斯廷礼拜堂揭幕，米开朗琪罗历时数年绘制的天顶画由此正式呈现。
text.en: Pope Julius II inaugurated the redecorated Sistine Chapel at an All Saints' Day Mass. Michelangelo's ceiling paintings had been completed that October.

items.source: Vatican Museums

title.en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences is founded

text.zh-CN: 中国科学院正式成立，随后接收和整合多个既有研究机构，逐步形成涵盖多个自然科学领域的综合研究体系。
text.en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences was founded. It subsequently incorporated existing research institutions and developed a broad system of natural-science research.

items.source: 中国科学院地质与地球物理研究所

references.name: 中国科学院地质与地球物理研究所

text.zh-CN: 里斯本及周边地区发生强烈地震，随后海啸与火灾加重灾害，城市遭到严重破坏。灾难也引发欧洲思想界对自然、社会与灾害应对的讨论。
text.en: A powerful earthquake struck Lisbon and the surrounding region, followed by a tsunami and fires. The devastation also prompted European debate about nature, society and responses to disaster.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.zh-CN: 美国进行“常春藤麦克”试验

text.zh-CN: 按马绍尔群岛当地日期，美国在埃尼威托克环礁进行“常春藤麦克”热核试验，验证两级热核装置设计，成为核武器发展史的重要节点。
text.en: On the local Marshall Islands date, the United States carried out the Ivy Mike test at Enewetak Atoll, demonstrating a two-stage thermonuclear device.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

title.en: Turkey adopts a new alphabet law

text.zh-CN: 土耳其通过采用和实施新字母表的法律，以基于拉丁字母的土耳其字母取代原有阿拉伯字母书写体系，并分阶段推行使用。
text.en: Turkey passed the law adopting its new Latin-based alphabet in place of the Ottoman Arabic script. Its use was introduced through a staged transition.

items.source: Wikipedia contributors

text.en: Cambodia declared its independence from France. The date became the country’s Independence Day; subsequent diplomatic settlements followed later.

text.zh-CN: 儿童教育电视节目《芝麻街》在美国首播，把字母、数字和生活知识融入木偶表演与短节目。首集以戈登向莎莉介绍芝麻街为线索展开。
text.en: Sesame Street made its television debut in the United States, combining educational material with puppets and short segments. Its first episode introduced Sally to the street.

text.zh-CN: 马丁·路德出生于艾斯莱本。他后来成为欧洲宗教改革的关键人物，通过神学论争、宗教写作和德语《圣经》翻译，对宗教与文化产生深远影响。
text.en: Martin Luther was born in Eisleben. He later became a central figure in the Protestant Reformation and translated the Bible into German.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

text.zh-CN: 苏联发射月球17号探测器，搭载月球车1号飞向月球。探测器于11月17日着陆，将月球车送往月面进行遥控巡视。
text.en: The Soviet Union launched Luna 17 carrying the Lunokhod 1 rover toward the Moon. Its landing followed on 17 November, a separate milestone from the launch.

items.source: 美国航空航天局 · NASA

text.zh-CN: 日本天皇裕仁在京都御所举行即位礼。他已于1926年继承皇位，这次仪式在两年后举行，成为昭和时期早期的一项重要国家典礼。
text.en: Emperor Hirohito’s enthronement ceremony was held at Kyoto Imperial Palace. He had succeeded to the throne in 1926, so this date marks the ceremony rather than his accession.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

text.zh-CN: 土耳其共和国首任总统穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克在伊斯坦布尔多尔玛巴赫切宫逝世。其国葬于11月21日在安卡拉举行，遗体后来迁葬至阿塔图尔克陵。
text.en: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the first president of the Republic of Turkey, died at Dolmabahçe Palace in Istanbul. His state funeral took place later.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

text.zh-CN: 美国货轮“埃德蒙·菲茨杰拉德”号在苏必利尔湖风暴中沉没，二十九名船员全部遇难。这场五大湖航运灾难后来促使人们持续研究恶劣天气与船舶安全。
text.en: The freighter Edmund Fitzgerald sank during a storm on Lake Superior, killing all 29 crew members. The disaster became a major subject of Great Lakes maritime research.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

title.zh-CN: 第一次世界大战西线停战
title.en: The Western Front armistice takes effect

text.zh-CN: 协约国与德国签署的停战协定在上午十一时生效，第一次世界大战西线的大规模战斗停止。停战不等于最终和约签订，《凡尔赛条约》是在次年签署。
text.en: The armistice between the Allies and Germany took effect at 11 a.m., ending major fighting on the Western Front. It was an armistice, not the final peace treaty.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

title.zh-CN: 中国人民解放军空军领导机构成立
title.en: The PLA Air Force leadership is established

text.zh-CN: 中国人民解放军空军领导机构在北京成立，刘亚楼出任首任空军司令员。此后空军逐步建设航空学校、航空兵部队及其他专业力量。
text.en: The leadership organization of the People’s Liberation Army Air Force was established in Beijing, with Liu Yalou as its first commander.

text.en: Angola became independent from Portugal. Independence did not end the conflict among rival movements, and the country subsequently endured a long civil war.

title.en: The U.S. Unknown Soldier is interred

text.zh-CN: 一名身份不明的第一次世界大战美军士兵被安葬在阿灵顿国家公墓的无名战士墓。总统哈定出席仪式，全国以默哀纪念战争死难者。
text.en: An unidentified American soldier of the First World War was interred in the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery. President Warren G. Harding attended the ceremony.

text.zh-CN: 罗得西亚由伊恩·史密斯领导的白人少数派政府发表单方面独立宣言，企图脱离英国管治。这项宣告没有获得国际普遍承认，津巴布韦则在1980年实现独立。
text.en: Ian Smith’s white-minority government issued Rhodesia’s unilateral declaration of independence from Britain. It did not gain general international recognition and was distinct from Zimbabwe’s independence in 1980.

text.zh-CN: 澳大利亚总督约翰·克尔解除总理高夫·惠特拉姆职务，并任命反对党领袖马尔科姆·弗雷泽组织看守政府。这是当年宪政危机的关键转折。
text.en: Governor-General John Kerr dismissed Australian prime minister Gough Whitlam and appointed opposition leader Malcolm Fraser to lead a caretaker government.

text.en: Sun Yat-sen was born in Cuiheng village, Xiangshan County, Guangdong, in what is now Zhongshan. He later became a leading figure in the movement to overthrow the Qing monarchy.

title.en: The San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge opens

text.zh-CN: 连接旧金山与奥克兰的海湾大桥正式通车，开通仪式在中午举行，车辆随后驶上桥面。它成为旧金山湾两岸之间的重要交通联系，开通当日吸引大量车辆通行。
text.en: The San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge opened to traffic after its midday opening ceremony. It is distinct from the Golden Gate Bridge, which opened the following year.

text.en: The Rosetta mission’s Philae lander reached comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko, achieving the first spacecraft landing on a comet. It bounced before settling at its final site.

text.en: Mathematician Hua Luogeng was born in Jintan, Jiangsu. He later contributed to number theory and promoted optimization and other mathematical methods in practical work.

title.en: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal begins

text.zh-CN: 美日海空力量在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛附近展开持续数日的交战，争夺岛屿增援与补给的控制权。战斗从11月12日延续至15日，是瓜岛战役的重要阶段。
text.en: American and Japanese forces began several days of naval and air fighting around Guadalcanal, contesting reinforcement and supply routes. The engagement continued through 15 November.

text.zh-CN: 旅行者1号飞掠土星，对其环系和卫星进行近距离观测，并取得土卫六厚重大气的资料。按世界时记载，它在11月12日达到距土星最近点。
text.en: Voyager 1 made its closest approach to Saturn on 12 November Universal Time, observing the planet’s rings and moons and investigating Titan’s thick atmosphere.

text.en: Emperor Akihito’s enthronement ceremony was held at Tokyo Imperial Palace. He had acceded to the throne in 1989; this date marks the later ceremony.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

text.zh-CN: 中国共产党领导的农民自卫军和义勇军在湖北黄安、麻城地区举行武装起义。起义队伍向黄安县城进发，成为后来鄂豫皖地区革命武装发展的一部分。
text.en: Communist-led peasant self-defence forces and volunteer units rose in the Huang’an–Macheng area of Hubei, advancing on Huang’an county town.

text.en: Disney’s Fantasia premiered at New York’s Broadway Theatre, combining animated sequences with classical music in a specially equipped roadshow presentation.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

title.zh-CN: 美国最高法院维持公交反隔离裁决
title.en: The Supreme Court affirms Browder v. Gayle

text.zh-CN: 美国最高法院维持下级法院在布劳德诉盖尔案中的裁决，认定阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利公共汽车上的种族隔离违反宪法。裁决的落实及抵制运动的结束发生在随后。
text.en: The U.S. Supreme Court upheld the ruling in Browder v. Gayle against racial segregation on Montgomery’s buses. Implementation of the ruling followed later.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

title.zh-CN: 鲁伊斯火山喷发与阿尔梅罗灾难

text.zh-CN: 哥伦比亚鲁伊斯火山在当地晚间喷发，热物质融化山顶冰雪，引发沿河谷奔流的火山泥石流。阿尔梅罗等城镇遭到严重破坏，成为火山灾害预警史上的惨痛案例。
text.en: Nevado del Ruiz erupted in Colombia. Meltwater from summit ice helped generate destructive lahars that devastated Armero and other communities.

text.zh-CN: 瑞典举行是否加入欧洲联盟的咨询性公投，赞成加入的一方获得多数票。瑞典随后于1995年1月1日成为欧盟成员，公投与正式入盟是两个不同阶段。
text.en: Swedish voters approved joining the European Union in a consultative referendum. Sweden subsequently became an EU member on 1 January 1995.

items.source: 维基百科 · Wikipedia

text.zh-CN: 巴黎及附近圣但尼在当地晚间发生协调实施的枪击和爆炸袭击，巴塔克兰剧院、餐饮场所及法兰西体育场周边受到袭击，造成大量平民伤亡。
text.en: Coordinated shootings and bombings struck Paris and nearby Saint-Denis, targeting the Bataclan theatre, restaurants and areas around the Stade de France.
